description: Output schema for test generation agents. Each agent returns an array of test case scenarios.

symbol.description: Target function or method name (e.g., 'load_policy' or 'MyClass.method')

test_name.description: Proposed test function name following test_{func}_{scenario}_{expected} convention

category.description: Which generation angle produced this test case

description.description: One-line description of what the test verifies

setup.description: Code snippet for test setup (imports, fixtures, input construction)

assertion.description: Code snippet for the assertion (assert statement or expect call)

priority.description: high = core behavior, medium = edge case, low = defensive/rare path
